player_prompt.intro:
Uzi kugera puzzle ya Sokoban. Uzi umukinnyi kandi uzajya itwara ibikoba byose kuri liti. 
        Ubakuye ari hafi ya kibokoboko, uzahabwa kuyitwara ukayitwara mu ruhare rwo rwo. 
        Oya utwara kibokoboko kuri mu mwobo, kandi si uzahabwa gukura kibokoboko.
        Ku mpapuro, ibintu bikurwa nkuko: 
        - Umukinnyi (we) aratangazwa 'P' 
        - Imwobo irerekana '#' 
        - Ibikoba bikurwa 'X' 
        - Liti ziriko zimeze nk' 'O'
        - Ibikoba kuri liti zirerekana '√'
        Uzahabwa kandi utumye [w] ku kuba, [a] ku muriro, [s] ku gisaro, na [d] ku mwanya.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Umusho w'umwito wari utumwe si mu buryo bworoshye. Utumye [up], [down], [left], [right] cyangwa [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.not_valid_action: Igikorwa cyatanzwe ntabwo ari igikorwa gifatika.
invalid_move.invalid_position: Kwimuka bidakwiriye - ntushobora kwimukira muri iyo mwanya.

outcome.win: Urakoze cyane, washoboye gukemura ikibazo cy'i Sokoban!
outcome.turn_limit: Igihe cyo guhinduranya cyageze. Ntiwakemuye ikibazo cy'ikibazo.
